title: Release v0.3.1
body:
Patch release bumping all packages from 0.3.0 → 0.3.1.

## Changes

- **Organized zod schema files** by folder structure for better maintainability
- **Updated documentation** across project

## Packages Released

All 7 packages use fixed versioning and release together:
- @objectstack/spec
- @objectstack/client
- @objectstack/driver-memory
- @objectstack/objectql
- @objectstack/plugin-hono-server
- @objectstack/runtime
- @objectstack/types

## Publishing

Merge to main triggers automated publishing via GitHub Actions. Requires `NPM_TOKEN` secret configured.

Manual publishing alternative:
```bash
pnpm run release
```
